errors.quote: where $W$ counts wires and $m$ is the label dimension
errors.problem: m=h^3 is the dimension of the ambient label space F=F^{⊗3}. Individual labels have dimensions from 0 to m.

errors.quote: $P_V-P_U$ is the identity on the residual $V\cap U^\perp$ and zero on its complement
errors.problem: It is zero on the orthogonal complement of the residual (U + V^⊥), not on an arbitrary complement. The paper says 'zero on its orthogonal complement'.

The page uses one t_T at times 2 and 5. In the paper, t is the indicator of the gate's own physical triple: the X triple at time 2 and the Y triple at time 5. With a single T the two labels are not nested, because <t_T> is not contained in t_T^⊥.

errors.quote: Gate labels at times $0$ to $7$ are $B\otimes\langle t_T\rangle,$ $B\otimes F,$
errors.problem: The factor Q is dropped without comment. The paper says 'All labels are tensored by Q and viewed as subspaces of F'. As written, these labels are not subspaces of F^{⊗3} (at stage 1, A⊗F=F), and the scratch-sink residual (A⊗F)⊗Q^⊥ cannot be formed.

errors.quote: The side edge has residual $R\otimes\langle t_S,t_T\rangle^\perp$ of dimension $h-2,$
errors.problem: This holds only for the side edge 2->5, and the residual also carries ⊗Q. A side wire has four edges, with residual dimensions a-1, (a-1)(h-1)+1, h-2 and 1.
The paper uses the normalized H=(1/√2)[[1,1],[1,-1]]. With the unnormalized Hadamard matrix, H diag(1,i)H=2C and H diag(1,-1)H=2σ.
This holds for an increasing edge U⊂V=U⊥E. The paper adds 'For a decreasing edge the right side is negated'. The page's later ± only partly covers this.

errors.quote: except at the $N$ source edges, where $2P_{U_a}$ has rank one
errors.problem: Every wire has a source edge. The exceptions are the N first edges of the X_a wires at stage 1, whose head label is exactly U_a.

This holds only after the diagonal corrections Z_{a,k} before the network and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} after it, the negation of the physical X outputs (the scalar network gives (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a)) and routing ρ(w) back to w. Without them the Y_a->X_a route carries -C^{⊗m}. The paper states these conditions explicitly.
